name: BongoCat Plugins 1.0.0
body:
## Changelog

### Input Source

#### ✨ Features

- Added the Input Source plugin, showing the current input source in real time.

### Key Sounds

#### ✨ Features

- Added the Key Sounds plugin with lively sound feedback for keyboard and mouse actions.

### Pomodoro

#### ✨ Features

- Added the Pomodoro plugin to help you stay focused and plan your time.

---

## 更新日志

### 输入法状态

#### ✨ 新功能

- 新增输入法状态插件，实时显示当前使用的输入法。

### 按键音效

#### ✨ 新功能

- 新增按键音效插件，为键盘和鼠标操作添加生动的声音反馈。

### 番茄时钟

#### ✨ 新功能

- 新增番茄时钟插件，通过专注计时帮助你保持专注、合理安排时间。

name: BongoCat 2.4.0
body:
## Changelog

### ✨ Features

- Added "Settings → Plugin Center" to manage and use plugins.
- Added three plugins: Pomodoro Timer, Key Sounds, and Input Method Status.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed startup not working correctly on Windows when the app runs as administrator.
- Fixed the model window occasionally being covered by other topmost windows on Windows when always-on-top was enabled.

### 🎨 Interface

- Added a standard macOS application menu with keyboard shortcuts for closing windows, quitting the app, opening settings, minimizing windows, and hiding the app.

## Downloads

- **Windows 10+**: [x64](https://github.com/ayangweb/BongoCat/releases/download/v2.4.0/BongoCat_2.4.0_x64.exe) | ARM64 (runs the x64 build through emulation)
- **macOS 12+**: [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/ayangweb/BongoCat/releases/download/v2.4.0/BongoCat-2.4.0-aarch64.dmg) | [Intel](https://github.com/ayangweb/BongoCat/releases/download/v2.4.0/BongoCat-2.4.0-x64.dmg) | [Homebrew](https://github.com/ayangweb/Homebrew-BongoCat)

## More models

- [Awesome-BongoCat](https://github.com/ayangweb/Awesome-BongoCat)

## Sponsors

- [NexaRelay](https://api.nexarelay.com)
- [ChooseC API](https://api.choosec.cn)

---

## 更新日志

### ✨ 新功能

- 新增「设置 → 插件中心」，可以在这里管理和使用插件。
- 新增番茄时钟、按键音效和输入法状态三个插件。

### 🐛 问题修复

- 修复 Windows 上以管理员身份运行后，开机自启动无法正常工作的问题。
- 修复 Windows 上模型窗口开启置顶后，偶尔被其他置顶窗口挡住的问题。

### 🎨 界面

- macOS 新增标准应用菜单，支持通过快捷键关闭窗口、退出应用、打开设置、最小化窗口和隐藏应用。
